reference/subsystems/ptc-runtime.md: # PTC 运行时 [English](/src/docs/subsystems/ptc-runtime.md) | 中文 PTC 执行[能力 seam](/src/.agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-06-13-capability-seams.zh.md)通过 [dsh-ptc-runtime](/src/packages/ptc-runtime/ptc-runtime) 提供 `ctx.ptcRuntime`。它针对 Host 绑定运行一个程序，报告输出、失败与适用的沙箱事实。PTC 执行是可选能力，不属于[智能体循环主干](/src/docs/subsystems/core.zh.md)。[PTC 基础](/src/.agents/notes/implemented/feature/2026-06-15-ptc.zh.md)负责注册表呈现，[类型化返回约定](/src/.agents/notes/implemented/feature/2026-07-20-ptc-typed-tool-returns.zh.md)负责绑定值，[沙箱 Node 决策](/src/.agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-09-11-sandboxed-node-ptc-runtime.zh.md)负责已发布的执行提供方。 源码：[`packages/ptc-runtime/ptc-runtime/src/types.ts`](/src/packages/ptc-runtime/ptc-runtime/src/types.ts) ## 运行：请求进，结果出 `PtcRunRequest` 包含程序、绑定、取消和可选执行选择。提供方的 `resolve` 验证支持的选择并应用部署默认值；`run` 接收目录与截止选择明确的 `PtcRunSpec`。省略 timeout 使用提供方默认值，数值请求封顶的经过时间预算，`null` 请求不设经过时间截止。提供方在执行前拒绝不支持的选择： ```ts type-equiv /** * Caller inputs for one program. The provider's resolve method validates supported * options and supplies directory, deadline, and authority before execution. */ interface PtcRunRequest { /** * The program source, in the runtime's {@link ../index.ts | language}. It * follows the provider's programFormat: an async function body supports * top-level `await` and `return`; REPL (`repl`, `scoped-repl`) and Script programs support top-level * declarations, `await`, and a final expression, but not top-level `return`. * The Script provider lowers top-level await; its executionInstructions and * documentation define retained-binding semantics. The completion value * becomes {@link PtcRunResult.value}. */ program: string /** Discard the completion without JSON validation when true; omission preserves the completion value. */ discardCompletion?: boolean /** * Object-identity owner for optional in-memory state. Omission requests a fresh * environment. Consumers must await runtime.release(owner) when the owner ends. * Stateless providers ignore this field; retained state is never durable. */ stateOwner?: object /** Host functions exposed to the program, one global object per namespace. */ bindings: PtcBindingNamespace[] /** Working directory in the mounted filesystem and subprocess execution world. */ cwd?: string /** * Elapsed execution budget in milliseconds. Omission uses provider defaults; * null requests no deadline. Providers validate and cap numeric budgets or reject unsupported choices. */ timeoutMs?: number | null /** Resolved authority for this execution. Providers without confinement reject an explicit policy. */ sandboxPolicy?: SandboxExecutionPolicy /** * Abort the run: the runtime stops the program (hard, even mid-loop) and * resolves with a {@link PtcRunFailure} of kind `'abort'`. In-flight * binding calls are the CALLER's to settle — the runtime only stops asking. */ signal?: AbortSignal } ``` ```ts type-equiv /** Fully resolved execution inputs; run never supplies a missing directory or deadline choice. */ interface PtcRunSpec extends PtcRunRequest { /** Absolute directory in the provider's execution world. */ cwd: string /** Positive finite elapsed budget in milliseconds after provider capping, or null for no deadline. */ timeoutMs: number | null } ``` ```ts type-equiv /** File confinement applied to a program, independently of its terminal outcome. */ interface PtcRunSandbox { /** File-effect mode used for this execution. */ mode: SandboxMode /** Program failure text matched backend diagnostics; not enforcement proof or an exhaustive denial record. */ denied: boolean /** Completeness reported by the selected confining backend; absent for full access. */ enforcement?: SandboxEnforcement } ``` 程序失败通过 `PtcRunResult.error` 返回；无效调用输入可能在执行前拒绝。沙箱模式、观察到的拒绝与强制完整性是独立事实，因此程序成功本身不能证明每项请求限制均已强制执行： ```ts type-equiv /** * The outcome of one run. An error is a FIELD on a resolved result, never a * rejection of `run()` — reporting a failed program is the caller's job, not * an exception path. */ interface PtcRunResult { /** Applied file policy and observed denial, when the provider enforces file policy. */ sandbox?: PtcRunSandbox /** * The program's completion value (a return or final REPL/Script expression), when it ran to * completion and the value crossed the runtime's lossless-JSON boundary. * Invalid or over-limit completions fail the run instead of substituting a * rendered string; a failed or value-less run leaves this absent. */ value?: PtcJsonValue /** * Captured text fragments retain their emitted line breaks. Concatenate adjacent text without separators. * Each source channel preserves emission order; interleaving * across independent channels is backend-dependent. Bounded only as part of * the outer result. */ output: PtcOutput[] /** Captured output or diagnostic text was truncated; execution still follows its normal completion, timeout and cancellation rules. */ outputTruncated?: boolean /** Present iff the run failed; see {@link PtcRunFailure} for the taxonomy. */ error?: PtcRunFailure } ``` ```ts type-equiv /** Source evaluation form, independent of retained program state. */ type PtcProgramFormat = 'function-body' | 'repl' | 'script' | 'scoped-repl' ``` `programFormat` 区分异步函数体、REPL 语句、scoped REPL 语句与脚本。REPL、scoped REPL 与 Script 程序接受顶层 `await`、声明和末尾表达式，不支持顶层 `return`。保留状态的 REPL 各次调用共用一个作用域；scoped REPL 每次调用开始时拿到之前调用留下的顶层绑定的拷贝，因此可以再次声明这些名字，而不改变之前的代码。Node Script 提供方转换顶层 await 并等待完成值；其[声明限制](/src/packages/ptc-runtime/ptc-runtime-node/README.zh.md)适用于转换后的程序。`retainsState` 独立于源码语法报告是否保留内存。`stateOwner` 是标识可选保留内存的进程内对象身份；不同对象相互隔离。消费者在所有者结束时等待 `release(owner)`；清理失败时该调用拒绝。省略所有者时仅执行一次，无状态提供方忽略所有权。[持久 Node 提供方](/src/packages/ptc-runtime/ptc-runtime-node/README.zh.md)定义重置和恢复行为；保留对象不会进入持久 Session 格式。 ## 绑定：宿主函数作为程序全局变量 每个 `PtcBindingNamespace` 成为一个异步可调用函数的全局对象；PTC 传入 `tools`。参数与返回值必须是无损 JSON，宿主签发的 `PtcImage` 和 `PtcInspectableValue` 描述符由提供方适配。提供方强制各自的传输上限；seam 不设统一的绑定字节上限。可选错误类描述符创建程序可见的类型化拒绝，无需在运行时内点名消费方。绑定名是自有属性，因此 `__proto__` 不能遍历原型： ```ts type-equiv /** * Program-visible typed rejection for one binding namespace. The runtime * injects a real error constructor under `name`; rejected member calls become * its instances and expose the exact member name through * `memberNameProperty`. Both strings are runtime data rather than knowledge * of a particular consumer such as PTC mode. */ interface PtcBindingErrorClass { /** Constructor global and resulting `Error.name`; same identifier rule as {@link PtcBindingNamespace.global}. */ name: string /** * Non-empty own property for the member name, excluding `name`, `message`, * and `stack` (`RESERVED_ERROR_MEMBERS`). Other property names are accepted. */ memberNameProperty: string } ``` ```ts type-equiv /** * A named group of {@link PtcBindingFunction}s the runtime exposes to the * program as one global object (e.g. `tools`). Function names are arbitrary * strings — a runtime must treat names like `__proto__` or `constructor` as * ordinary own properties (null-prototype construction), never as prototype * collisions. */ interface PtcBindingNamespace { /** * The global identifier the program sees. Must match `[A-Za-z_$][A-Za-z0-9_$]*` * and exclude ECMAScript keywords and strict-mode names (`RESERVED_BINDING_WORDS`). * Runtime output globals (`console`, `inspect`, `Image` in `RESERVED_BINDING_GLOBALS`) * are also refused. */ global: string /** The callable members, keyed by the exact name the program calls. */ functions: Record /** Optional program-visible typed rejection contract for this namespace. */ errorClass?: PtcBindingErrorClass } ``` ```ts type-equiv /** A lossless JSON value transferable through the dependency-light Service Definition. */ type PtcJsonValue = null | boolean | number | string | PtcJsonValue[] | { [key: string]: PtcJsonValue } ``` ```ts type-equiv /** * One host-side function exposed to the program as an async callable. The * runtime bridges calls to it (possibly across a serialization boundary), so * `args` must be lossless JSON; resolutions also support host-issued PtcImage and * PtcInspectableValue values. An inspectable resolution delivers its JSON object * or array to the program and uses its text only when that unchanged value is * inspected directly. A runtime rejects a lossy or non-cloneable value with a * descriptive error rather than corrupting the run. No seam-level byte cap * applies to a binding resolution. A rejection of this function surfaces inside * the program as a rejection of the corresponding call. */ type PtcBindingFunction = (args: unknown) => Promise ``` `@deepseek-ai/dsh-ptc-runtime` 导出的 `PtcInspectableValue` 通过 `new PtcInspectableValue(value, text)`，为无损 JSON 对象或数组关联宿主提供的文本。提供方向程序交付数据本身，不暴露描述符，也不添加程序可见属性。只有直接 `inspect` 原结果，且其数据仍与初始快照一致时，才使用附带文本；空文本不产生输出。拷贝、字段选择、修改后的结果和嵌套值使用普通格式。该关联由 Node 进程拥有，不序列化到 Session 日志，复制程序值也不会传递该关联。参见 [`src/inspectable-value.ts`](/src/packages/ptc-runtime/ptc-runtime/src/inspectable-value.ts)。 数据中可以包含宿主提供的 `PtcImage` 描述符。提供方在展示快照中保留对应程序 `Image` 的身份。直接展示未修改的容器时输出附带文本；展示 Image 字段时输出该图片。 ```ts public-api /** A binding result whose unchanged object or array displays the supplied text when inspected directly. */ declare class PtcInspectableValue { readonly [key: string]: PtcJsonValue; /** The JSON object or array delivered unchanged to the program. */ readonly value: PtcJsonValue[] | { [key: string]: PtcJsonValue }; /** Text shown by a direct inspection of the unchanged value; empty text emits nothing. */ readonly text: string; /** * Associate an object or array with its host-authored inspection text. * @param value - Lossless JSON data retained for programmatic access. * @param text - Text to display instead of generic object formatting. */ constructor(value: PtcJsonValue[] | { [key: string]: PtcJsonValue }, text: string); } ``` ## 捕获的输出与失败分类体系 `output` 按发出顺序保存文本和图片条目：文本使用 `{ type: 'text', text }`，图片使用 `{ type: 'image', attachment }`。文本条目保留实际输出的换行，相邻文本直接拼接，不额外插入分隔符。每个来源通道都保留发出顺序；独立通道之间的交错顺序由后端决定。宿主绑定返回 `PtcImage` 描述符，包含附件引用和可在执行环境读取的 `path`；程序收到带有该路径和存储像素尺寸的 `Image`。Node 提供方对序列化文本、图片描述符、完成值或诊断一起计量；捕获输出截断通过 `outputTruncated` 独立报告，要求返回的完成值保持无损。预算优先级与执行语义见 [Node 提供方](/src/packages/ptc-runtime/ptc-runtime-node/README.zh.md)。 ```ts public-api /** A stored image readable from the program's execution environment. */ declare class PtcImage { readonly [key: string]: PtcJsonValue; /** Absolute attachment file path readable in the execution world. */ readonly path: string; /** Stored image selected when the program inspects this value. */ readonly attachment: Readonly; /** * Describe one immutable image file in the execution world. * @param path - Absolute path to the stored image. * @param attachment - Reference to the immutable stored image. */ constructor(path: string, attachment: ImageAttachmentRef); } ``` ```ts type-equiv /** Raw text fragments and inspected images in emission order; concatenate adjacent text without separators. */ type PtcOutput = { type: 'text'; text: string } | { type: 'image'; attachment: ImageAttachmentRef } ``` 失败类型是**正交的结果，独立报告**（见 [defensive-patterns](/src/docs/defensive-patterns/general.zh.md)）：预算耗尽不是异常，中止不是超时，基底崩溃（如 OOM）也不是二者中的任何一个： ```ts type-equiv /** * Why a run failed. The kinds are orthogonal outcomes reported independently * (per docs/defensive-patterns/general.md): a budget expiry is not an exception, an * abort is not a timeout, and a substrate death is neither. * * - `'exception'` — the program threw or failed to parse/transform. * - `'timeout'` — an implementation-owned budget expired; the message says which. * - `'abort'` — {@link PtcRunRequest.signal} fired. * - `'worker-exit'` — the execution substrate died without settling (e.g. OOM). * - `'invalid-output'` — the completion value was not lossless JSON. * - `'output-limit'` — the required completion value exceeded the configured cap. * - `'protocol'` — the program sent invalid or over-budget control traffic. * - `'sandbox-unavailable'` — required confinement could not be established. */ interface PtcRunFailure { /** The failure class (see the interface doc for each kind's meaning). */ kind: 'exception' | 'timeout' | 'abort' | 'worker-exit' | 'invalid-output' | 'output-limit' | 'protocol' | 'sandbox-unavailable' /** Human-readable detail, suitable for feeding back to a model to self-correct. */ message: string } ``` ## 服务 `PtcRuntime` 定义于 [`src/index.ts`](/src/packages/ptc-runtime/ptc-runtime/src/index.ts)。`resolve(request)` 返回完整执行输入，`run(spec)` 执行它们。`executionInstructions` 提供由运行时拥有的使用说明，供消费方呈现。支持逐次覆盖时，`timeout` 报告配置的经过时间默认值和上限；每次请求仍由 `resolve` 验证并截断。`language` 标识源码语言，供消费方检查自身要求（参见 [PTC 执行器](/src/packages/core/tool-executor-ptc/README.zh.md)）；`isolation` 描述执行基底，不作安全声明。`sandboxMode` 声明文件策略支持，不提供约束的提供方返回 `undefined`。每个实现将各次运行的程序状态分离，并在资源释放期间终止且等待活跃执行。 ## Cordis API Generated from source by `scripts/gen-cordis-catalog.ts` (verified fresh by `pnpm run verify-cordis-catalog` in doc-sync; regenerate with `pnpm run gen-cordis-catalog`) — the language sides differ only in locale-specific paired document paths. Signature blocks use a `ts cordis-catalog` fence and keep the original source JSDoc; dispatch modes are defined in the [primer](/src/docs/cordis-primer.zh.md), and the framework-inherited `ctx` API lives in [cordis-api/inherited.md](/src/docs/cordis-api/inherited.md). ### `ctx.ptcRuntime` — `PtcRuntime` (abstract seam) Registers one `ctx.ptcRuntime` implementation. Program, budget, abort, and substrate failures resolve in PtcRunResult; only Service Definition contract misuse rejects, with PtcRuntimeError. Implementations bridge structured-cloneable bindings, materialize each declared namespace rejection class, treat programs as hostile peers, isolate distinct state owners, and terminate and await in-flight runs during disposal. ```ts cordis-catalog /** * Release an owner's retained environment and await its execution resources. * Stateless providers have no retained resources to release. * @param owner - The exact object supplied as the request's state owner. * @returns Completion after all owned execution resources have been released. * @throws When managed resource cleanup fails. */ release(owner: object): Promise /** * Register source evaluated once when each execution environment is created. * Registration must precede the first run admission; only one initializer may * be registered. Current bindings are installed before initialization. Its * completion is discarded; logs, timeout, cancellation and output bounds share * the first run. Initialization failure discards the environment without * executing the user program or rolling back external effects. * @param program - Initialization source in the provider's language and format. * @returns An idempotent async disposer that stops admission, cancels and drains * admitted runs, and releases environments. Failed cleanup blocks execution * until the disposer succeeds on retry. The caller owns this disposer. * @throws When unsupported, registered twice, registered after admission, or invalid. */ registerEnvironmentInitializer(program: string): () => Promise /** * Resolve supported options and provider defaults before execution. * @param request - Program, bindings, cancellation and optional execution choices. * @returns Complete directory, deadline and supported authority for run. * @throws When an explicit choice is invalid or unsupported by this provider; contract misuse throws {@link PtcRuntimeError}. */ abstract resolve(request: PtcRunRequest): PtcRunSpec /** * Execute resolved inputs; program outcomes resolve as result fields. * @param spec - directory, deadline, program, bindings, cancellation and supported policy. * @returns Captured output and the execution outcome. */ abstract run(spec: PtcRunSpec): Promise ``` Source: [`packages/ptc-runtime/ptc-runtime/src/index.ts`](/src/packages/ptc-runtime/ptc-runtime/src/index.ts)

reference/subsystems/web.title: Web 访问
reference/subsystems/web.md: # Web 访问 [English](/src/docs/subsystems/web.md) | 中文 Web 访问 seam 是一个[能力 seam](/src/.agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-06-24-web-capability-seam.zh.md)，在同一个 `ctx.web` 服务上横跨**两项操作**（search 与 fetch），并拆分到多个包：Service Definition（[dsh-web](/src/packages/web/web)，`ctx.web` + 提供方注册表）、Service Provider（[dsh-web-search-deepseek](/src/packages/web/web-search-deepseek)、[dsh-web-deepseek-api](/src/packages/web/web-deepseek-api)、[dsh-web-fetch-http](/src/packages/web/web-fetch-http)）与 Consumer（[dsh-tool-web](/src/packages/web/tool-web)，即 `web_search`/`web_fetch` 工具 schema）。Web 是**一项可选能力**，不属于 agent loop（智能体循环）主干，因此其词汇定义在此而非 [core.md](/src/docs/subsystems/core.zh.md) 中。更换 search 提供方不会改变模型提交查询的方式，更换 fetch 提供方也不会改变模型请求 URL 的方式。 源码：[`packages/web/web/src/types.ts`](/src/packages/web/web/src/types.ts) ## 为什么一项能力包含两项操作 搜索与抓取既不共享请求 schema，也不共享业务逻辑，但它们被有意设计为同一个 `ctx.web` 中间层：一个提供方选择策略的所有者、一套中止与错误词汇，以及一个面向产品的「此 harness 如何访问 Web」配置界面。代价是服务上并行的 `searchX`／`fetchX` 方法对；这种并行是有意为之，而不是遗漏了可抽取的共性。提供方注册的是**能力**（`WebSearchProvider` 或 `WebFetchProvider`），而非工具；面向模型的名称、schema、提示词引导与展示全部集中在唯一的消费方 `dsh-tool-web` 中。 ## 搜索请求与结果 每个 seam 请求只携带一个 `query`。消费方 `dsh-tool-web` 接受必填的 `queries` 数组，并把它扇出为多个独立 seam 请求；单元素数组执行一次搜索。`maxResults` 是消费方自有的上限（`dsh-tool-web` 的 `searchMaxResults` 配置，默认 `10`），通过 seam 传递并在返回时强制执行——如果提供方返回超量，seam 截断 `sources[]` 并设置 `truncated`。`llmProvider` 指明搜索所服务的模型请求的提供方路由；`dsh-tool-web` 把它设为发起调用的 Session 最近一次模型请求的路由。 ```ts type-equiv /** * What one search-capable backend is asked to search. Each request carries one * query; a consumer may issue several requests. `maxResults` is a * `dsh-tool-web`-layer bound passed through unchanged and enforced on the way * back by the seam (see {@link WebSearchResult}). */ interface WebSearchRequest { readonly query: string /** * Upper bound on returned sources; the seam truncates to it. Omitted = no * bound. `dsh-tool-web` always sets it. A provider whose API supports a * result-count control (the DeepSeek Search API's `count`) should apply it * at the request layer as a cost/latency optimization; the seam enforces the * bound regardless. */ readonly maxResults?: number /** * Provider route id of the model request this search serves. While no search * provider is configured, the seam selects with it, as `searchReady()` selects * with its argument. Omitted = the search serves no model request. */ readonly llmProvider?: string } ``` ```ts type-equiv /** * Normalized search outcome. `content` is optional provider-generated answer * text or summary (DeepSeek returns none; a provider whose API generates an * answer returns it here). * `sources[]` is the portable citation shape. `truncated` is set by the seam * when it cut `sources[]` down to `maxResults`. */ interface WebSearchResult { /** Optional provider-generated answer text, search context, or summary. */ readonly content?: string /** Citeable sources, already truncated to the request's `maxResults`. */ readonly sources: readonly WebSearchSource[] /** True when the seam dropped sources to honor `maxResults`. */ readonly truncated: boolean } ``` ```ts type-equiv /** * One citeable source. A source always has a URL; `title`, `snippet`, `summary`, * and `publishedAt` are optional because not every provider returns them — forcing * adapters to invent them would make the seam lie (some providers return * URL-only citations). `dsh-tool-web` renders `title ?? hostname(url)` for display. */ interface WebSearchSource { readonly url: string readonly title?: string /** Short excerpt suited to display. */ readonly snippet?: string /** Longer excerpt suited to model reading; consumers bound its length. */ readonly summary?: string /** Publication/crawl timestamp as a provider-supplied ISO-8601 string. */ readonly publishedAt?: string } ``` ## 抓取请求与结果 ```ts type-equiv /** * What one fetch-capable backend is asked to retrieve. The request deliberately * omits timeout, format, prompt, and extraction controls: cancellation is a * direct execution argument, while presentation and higher-level LLM concerns * belong outside safe retrieval. */ interface WebFetchRequest { readonly url: string } ``` HTTP 状态码是被抓取资源状态的一部分，不自动视为失败：即使一次成功的网络抓取收到 `404` 或 `500` 响应，也仍会产出一个 `WebFetchResult`，其中包含状态码和长度受限的已解码正文。`url` 是经过允许的重定向后的最终 URL。`WebError` 仅用于无法安全获取或表示资源的情况。 ```ts type-equiv /** * Normalized fetch outcome. A successful network fetch of a non-2xx response is * a result, not an error: the status code is part of the fetched resource * state. {@link WebError} is reserved for failures to safely retrieve or * represent the resource. */ interface WebFetchResult { /** The final URL after allowed redirects (the request URL is in the request). */ readonly url: string /** HTTP status code of the fetched response. */ readonly statusCode: number /** Decoded body, classified by content kind. */ readonly body: WebFetchBody /** True when the provider capped the decoded body. */ readonly truncated: boolean } ``` ```ts type-equiv /** * The decoded body of a fetched resource. A CLOSED discriminated union owned by * `dsh-web`: the provider decodes the kind and `dsh-tool-web` renders it, so a * new kind is a coordinated change across known packages, not a plugin * extension. Consumers `switch` on `kind` ending in `default: assertNever(...)` * so adding a kind breaks compilation at every consumer until handled. Each arm * stays its own object literal even where fields coincide, so an arm can gain * fields the others lack. */ type WebFetchBody = | { readonly kind: 'html'; readonly content: string } | { readonly kind: 'text'; readonly content: string } ``` ## 提供方可用性 提供方的 `available(): boolean` 是一个廉价的本地检查（凭证是否存在、配置是否可解析），**禁止发起网络调用**。它是执行时选择提供方的输入，而不是健康检查系统：`search()`／`fetch()` 会读取它来选择可用的提供方。选择失败时，调用方会收到可据以分支处理的结构化 `WebError`；其错误代码和消息会说明缺失的 id 或存在歧义的候选集。与可用性不同，注册情况在操作运行前即可观测：`listProviders()` 按 `id`、可选的 `title` 和可选的多语言 `description` 返回每个已注册的搜索与抓取提供方，每次注册或注销后都会触发不带载荷的 `web/providers-changed` 事件；可用性仍只在操作运行时体现。 搜索或抓取提供方还可以实现 `ready(llmProvider): Promise`，这是只检查配置、禁止发起网络调用的判断：它回答为该对话路由上的模型请求发起的操作是否有可发送的凭据。`searchReady(llmProvider?)` 与 `fetchReady(llmProvider?)` 只询问 `search()` 或 `fetch()` 会选中的提供方，把没有 `ready()` 的提供方视为就绪，并在选择失败时回答 true，因为对应操作会把该失败报告为 `WebError`。就绪判断不是选择输入；`dsh-tool-web` 把它作为 `web_search` 与 `web_fetch` 的激活条件，因此路由回答 false 的模型步骤既不声明也不派发该工具。DeepSeek Search 与 Fetch API 提供方依据该路由在账号令牌与 API 密钥之间选择，见 [web-deepseek-api 鉴权](/src/packages/web/web-deepseek-api/README.zh.md)一节。 选择从不依赖注册顺序、配置顺序或 HMR（热模块替换）顺序：一项能力要么有显式的提供方 id（配置 `searchProvider`／`fetchProvider`，或填充同一字段的对应环境变量），要么在恰好只有一个可用提供方注册时自动选择；如果存在多个可用提供方却未配置 id，则抛出 `WEB_PROVIDER_AMBIGUOUS`，而不会选用最先注册的提供方。搜索在这条规则之前有一条固定的优先规则：没有配置 id 时，为 `deepseek-official` 或 `deepseek-account` 路由上的模型请求发起的搜索运行 `deepseek-official`（不按次收费的 DeepSeek Messages 搜索），其他路由上以及不服务于模型请求的搜索运行 `deepseek-search-api`，前提是该提供方已注册且可用。`searchReady(llmProvider)` 选中的提供方与请求携带该 `llmProvider` 的搜索相同。每次操作在执行时读取配置的 id，因此保存的设置变更无需重新挂载 `ctx.web` 即对下一次搜索或抓取生效。 ## 抓取网络策略 已交付的 Cordis、Code 与 Standard preset 会在所有 sandbox 和审批模式下暴露 `web_fetch`，无需逐次确认。文件 sandbox preset 不管辖 Web 网络访问。需要确认步骤的部署必须添加 `tools/pre-execute` 策略或禁用抓取。 HTTP 提供方不限制目的地址：`web_fetch` 会像访问其他主机一样访问 loopback、内网与云元数据主机，模型也可以把数据发送到它能访问的任何 URL。跨源重定向需要新的工具调用。需要阻止模型访问私有目的地址的部署必须使用网络隔离、`tools/pre-execute` 策略，或不挂载抓取工具。 ## 错误 `WebError extends HarnessError`（[core.md](/src/docs/subsystems/core.zh.md) 错误分类体系），带有 `code: string`（开放式，与其他 seam 的错误一致——`LlmError`、`SubagentError`），而非封闭联合类型：提供方可以在不修改 `dsh-web` 的情况下抛出自己的错误代码，消费方必须容忍未知错误代码。错误代码按所有者划分。共享的 `WebRuntime` 约定会抛出与 seam 无关的错误代码：`WEB_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE`、`WEB_PROVIDER_CONFIGURED_MISSING`、`WEB_PROVIDER_CONFIGURED_UNAVAILABLE`、`WEB_PROVIDER_AMBIGUOUS`、`WEB_DUPLICATE_PROVIDER`（注册时的编程错误，类似 `LlmRuntime` 的 `DUPLICATE_ADAPTER`）、`WEB_ABORTED`，以及 `WEB_PROVIDER_ERROR`（提供方自身故障经 seam 暴露时使用的兜底代码）。抓取传输层错误代码由 `dsh-web-fetch-http` 实现拥有，不同的抓取后端无需抛出它们：`WEB_INVALID_URL`、`WEB_BLOCKED_URL`、`WEB_REDIRECT_BLOCKED`、`WEB_FETCH_TOO_LARGE`、`WEB_FETCH_TIMEOUT`、`WEB_UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT_TYPE`，以及网络故障类别 `WEB_FETCH_DNS_FAILED`、`WEB_FETCH_CONNECTION_REFUSED`、`WEB_FETCH_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT`、`WEB_FETCH_CERTIFICATE_INVALID`、`WEB_FETCH_CONNECTION_INTERRUPTED`、`WEB_FETCH_NETWORK_UNREACHABLE` 和 `WEB_FETCH_NETWORK_ERROR`。Web 中的 `web_fetch` 行会为网络故障类别显示本地化摘要，并在输出中保留记录的消息。 ## 服务 `WebRuntime` 注册搜索与抓取提供方，以 `WEB_DUPLICATE_PROVIDER` 拒绝重复 id，并在执行时以结构化的选择错误解析提供方。本地抓取后端仅接受 HTTP(S)、拒绝凭证、经已安装的代理策略发送每个请求、对每一次同源重定向跳转重复 URL 校验、限制重定向次数、字节数、字符数和时间，并解码正文；展示由工具负责。 ## Cordis API Generated from source by `scripts/gen-cordis-catalog.ts` (verified fresh by `pnpm run verify-cordis-catalog` in doc-sync; regenerate with `pnpm run gen-cordis-catalog`) — the language sides differ only in locale-specific paired document paths. Signature blocks use a `ts cordis-catalog` fence and keep the original source JSDoc; dispatch modes are defined in the [primer](/src/docs/cordis-primer.zh.md), and the framework-inherited `ctx` API lives in [cordis-api/inherited.md](/src/docs/cordis-api/inherited.md). ### `ctx.web` — `WebRuntime` The web access service. Registered as `ctx.web` (one instance per context) and exposed to Clients as the `web` Remote namespace (`listProviders`). Selection semantics (resolved at execution time, never order-dependent): - A configured id that is registered and `available()` → that provider. - A configured id not registered → `WEB_PROVIDER_CONFIGURED_MISSING`. - A configured id registered but unavailable → `WEB_PROVIDER_CONFIGURED_UNAVAILABLE`. - No search id configured, and the provider assigned to the route of the model request the search serves is usable → that provider: `deepseek-official` (Messages search) on the `deepseek-official` and `deepseek-account` routes, `deepseek-search-api` on every other route and outside a model request. - No id configured, exactly one registered usable provider → that provider. - No id configured, multiple usable providers → `WEB_PROVIDER_AMBIGUOUS`. - No id configured, no usable provider → `WEB_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE`. ```ts cordis-catalog /** * Register a search provider. `listProviders()` lists it until the * registration is disposed, which happens with the calling fiber or through * the returned disposer; registration and disposal each emit * `web/providers-changed`. Throws {@link WebError} `WEB_DUPLICATE_PROVIDER` * if its id is already registered for search. * @param provider - the provider; its `id` is the registry key. * @returns the disposer that unregisters the provider. */ registerSearchProvider(provider: WebSearchProvider): () => void /** * Register a fetch provider, with the listing, disposal, and event behavior * of {@link WebRuntime.registerSearchProvider}. Throws {@link WebError} * `WEB_DUPLICATE_PROVIDER` if its id is already registered for fetch. * @param provider - the provider; its `id` is the registry key. * @returns the disposer that unregisters the provider. */ registerFetchProvider(provider: WebFetchProvider): () => void /** * List every registered search and fetch provider for provider pickers. * Availability does not filter the lists. * @returns detached `{ id, title, description }` entries per capability, in registration order. */ @Remote listProviders(): WebProviderList /** * Run one search through the selected provider. Resolves the provider at call * time with the selection rules above; throws {@link WebError} when the * capability cannot run. The seam enforces `request.maxResults` on the result: * if the provider over-returns, `sources[]` is truncated and `truncated` set. * @param request - the query, the optional result limit, and the route of the model request the search serves. * @param signal - optional cancellation signal forwarded to the provider. * @returns the provider's results, capped to `request.maxResults`. */ async search(request: WebSearchRequest, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise /** * Whether the provider `search()` would select can authenticate a search made for a * model request on the `llmProvider` chat route. Asks only that provider's `ready()`; * one without `ready()` counts as ready. Makes no network calls. A selection failure * answers true, because `search()` reports that failure as a structured `WebError`. * @param llmProvider - the provider route id of the model request, when known. * @returns false only when the selected provider reports that it cannot authenticate. */ async searchReady(llmProvider?: string): Promise /** * Retrieve one URL through the selected provider. Resolves the provider at * call time with the selection rules above; throws {@link WebError} when the * capability cannot run. A non-2xx response is a result, not a throw. * @param request - the URL plus retrieval options. * @param signal - optional cancellation signal forwarded to the provider. * @returns the retrieval outcome; non-2xx responses resolve descriptively. */ async fetch(request: WebFetchRequest, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise /** * Whether the provider `fetch()` would select can authenticate a fetch made for a * model request on the `llmProvider` chat route. Asks only that provider's `ready()`; * one without `ready()` counts as ready. Makes no network calls. A selection failure * answers true, because `fetch()` reports that failure as a structured `WebError`. * @param llmProvider - the provider route id of the model request, when known. * @returns false only when the selected provider reports that it cannot authenticate. */ async fetchReady(llmProvider?: string): Promise ``` Source: [`packages/web/web/src/index.ts`](/src/packages/web/web/src/index.ts) ### `web/*` events #### `web/providers-changed` — emit The set of registered search or fetch providers changed: one provider registered, or its registration was disposed. Payload-free; consumers re-read `ctx.web.listProviders()` (Remote `web/listProviders`) for the new list. Fires after each committed registry mutation. Observer failures are contained and cannot veto the mutation. ```ts cordis-catalog /** * The set of registered search or fetch providers changed: one provider * registered, or its registration was disposed. Payload-free; consumers * re-read `ctx.web.listProviders()` (Remote `web/listProviders`) for the * new list. Fires after each committed registry mutation. Observer failures * are contained and cannot veto the mutation. * @mode emit */ 'web/providers-changed'(): void ``` Source: [`packages/web/web/src/types.ts`](/src/packages/web/web/src/types.ts)
